run_improve_description_cli: run the improve_description CLI to generate an improved skill description from eval results JSON and skill directory
call_claude_api: call claude -p with a prompt on stdin and return the text response using Claude Code auth
improve_skill_description: improve a skill description based on eval results by identifying failed and false triggers and generating a better prompt
parse_skill_md: parse a SKILL.md file from a skill directory to extract the skill name and content
run_eval_results: run eval results analysis to identify failed triggers and false triggers for skill description optimization
